hypothesis_title: Statistically Sophisticated Low-Volatility 4th Orthogonal Alpha Sleeve
hypothesis_description: 도훈 mandate 2026-05-13 Session 81: 4th orthogonal alpha source 발굴. 현 PG2 admit (STR_1715_AR_on_M4_R05_overlay_PG2, SR 1.9536) 대비 cor<0.30 직교 alpha sleeve로 SR 2.0+ 마일스톤 잔여 gap 0.0464 closure 목적. Theme: 통계적으로 가다듬은 저변동성 (단순 D26/D27 quintile rank 회피). 방법론 자율 탐색 — 후보 axes: (1) idiosyncratic vol decomposition (Ang-Hodrick-Xing-Zhang 2006), (2) beta-adjusted vol / BAB (Frazzini-Pedersen 2014), (3) realized + GARCH forecast combo, (4) robust vol estimator (MAD/trimmed sd), (5) sector-neutralized vol, (6) HAR-RV mean-reverting (Corsi 2009), (7) regime-conditional vol (BOCPD/HMM), (8) downside-vol / semi-deviation (Estrada 2007). 직교성 mandate: rank_cor < 0.30 + returns_cor < 0.40 vs STR_1715_AR_on_M4_R05_overlay_PG2 admit lineage frozen. AX-005 v1.2 scope: low-vol single-sleeve long-only fail risk 인지 → multi-sleeve composite OR quality+low-vol multi-axis 으로 정합. AX-001 v2 conditional defense 4-axis 검증 의무. V6 패스 결정 (data mining DSR N=37 FAIL) 인지 — 본 cycle은 ex-ante grid N<=5 strict, post-hoc grid 탐색 금지.
